title: English letter frequency rose
intent: Compare six English letter frequencies through equal-angle sectors whose radii vary on one fixed scale.

ai.create: Create six native radius-extending bars from Observable's alphabet rows, using letter angle bands and a fixed frequency scale whose responsive pixel range runs from 30% to 100% of the available radius.
ai.maintain: Change the selected letters without changing source order, the dataset-wide maximum, the responsive 30%-to-100% radial range, the physical zero-radius baseline, raw row identity, or semantic letter keys and colors.
